title: devx SDK daily scratchpad - doc gaps & sample app to-dos
content:
Morning quick notes - 2026-03-05
Notes to self / running list (mostly bullet-y, TODOs and half-written thoughts)

Context: shipping the new JS/py SDK updates and sample todo-app. Priorities this week: close doc gaps that keep customers blocked (streaming + function-calling examples), finish end-to-end sample app, add small tutorial for Dedicated/private deployment gotchas.

Top blockers:
- streaming docs: current example in hosted-api doc is missing server-side SSE/WS handling for partial responses (customers confused about how to reconnect / resume). Need short runnable example (node express + fetch, and python aiohttp).
- function-calling: examples show schema only; no working sample that wires function call outputs back into app flow (e.g., extract entities -> call API -> apply changes). Add a minimal end-to-end demo and an integration test checklist.
- error handling: SDK surface does not clearly document retry/backoff defaults and how to detect rate limit vs transient GPU OOM; add a small table and recommended patterns.
- sample todo-app: missing (1) auth refresh example, (2) client-side streaming UI, (3) how to pin model/rollout config for Dedicated mode.

TODOS (prioritized):
1) Streaming runnable examples (high)
   - Node express SSE endpoint that proxies Redwood streaming + client fetch stream handler (Ryan to review)
   - Python asyncio aiohttp + client sample (Mikaela to draft)
   - Add note: emphasize chunk parsing + partial JSON handling for structured output
   - Linked ticket: DXDOCS-98 (create step-by-step)

2) Function-calling end-to-end (high)
   - Create minimal sample: message -> model suggests action {type: update_todo, id, fields} -> app applies update -> responds with confirmation
   - Add unit test harness that asserts function call shape + handling for unknown functions
   - Add warning: do not treat model-suggested actions as authoritative without server-side validation

3) Error handling & SLO guidance (medium)
   - Doc table: HTTP 429 vs 503 vs 5xx vs specific provider errors; mapping to retry/backoff suggestions
   - Example code: exponential backoff wrapper + max retries = 5

4) Sample app polish (medium)
   - Add auth refresh (short snippet showing token refresh flow in SDK wrapper)
   - Add pinned model config for Dedicated (how to set model version + fallback policy)
   - Streaming UI: small React component example that appends tokens as they arrive (avoid re-render thrash)

5) Quick tutorials (low)
   - One-pager: migrating from public hosted -> Dedicated (checklist + common pitfalls)
   - Troubleshooting: when latency jumps after quantization changes (check kernel selection, sequence length mismatch)

Quick notes / fragments to capture:
- Consider adding a "recipe" section in docs for common tasks: streaming chat, embeddings + similarity search, function-calling workflow, batch jobs. Keep recipes <300 lines of code.
- Add CLI snippet to lint local sample app against prod-grade settings (timeout, retries)
- For sample app: include a small dataset (5 todos) and a script to seed it. Keep DB to sqlite for simplicity.
- UX note: demonstrate client fallback to non-streaming mode when SSE not available.
- Testing: add an e2e test matrix (hosted/dedicated/private) but start with hosted smoke checks in CI.

Links to follow up (notes to self):
- Check Evan's PR for streaming backend helper (GH PR #4521) - merge once node example updated
- File DXDOCS-102 for adding retry table to core SDK docs
- Slack convo: #devx-sdk thread "streaming: chunk parsing issues" (refer to examples there)

Small drafts I want in the doc (write this later):
- Short intro paragraph for streaming: "Streaming responses allow apps to display partial content as tokens are generated. Use when UX benefits from incremental data (chat, long generation). Beware: partial JSON requires robust parsing; always support fallback to non-streaming read."
- Code snippet placeholders: JS fetch streaming handler, python async for chunk in resp.aiter_bytes():...

End-of-day checklist (today):
- [ ] Draft Node streaming example (in repo under examples/streaming-node)
- [ ] Draft Python streaming example (examples/streaming-py)
- [ ] Open PR for function-calling demo with tests
- [ ] Create JIRA tickets for retry table + sample app auth refresh
- [ ] Quick sync with Devon/Mikaela at 3pm to align on sample app scope

Random TODOs / brain dump (low priority):
- Consider a short "common pitfalls" FAQ at top of SDK docs (searchability will reduce support tickets)
- Add a short checklist for onboarded customers: sample app deployed, 1 canary user, observable metrics dashboard linked
